title: Devil-risk elimination project plan (OpenAI-last)
orderingRationale: Kill false-green gates first (metric theater + ship-check freshness) so no one ships on stale 80.6% / structural 100.
Then deploy safety (git remote) so recovery artifacts can leave the laptop.
Then visibility (index↔seamless gap + enrichedOnly path orphans) so users/runtime see what index claims.
Then offline quality depth (freeze volume, workplaceTasks, glossary pivot, dual-writer, provenance, agent-card labeling).
OpenAI liveShare polish + QA absolute bar last — only after offline foundations stop inventing new dilution.
doNotRules: Do NOT cite competitivenessScore / structural diagnostic as ship-ready (informational only; currently 100 while liveSharePct=22).
Do NOT treat content/pipeline/ship-check-report.json as truth unless generatedAt ≥ content/index.json mtime AND ≥ ops-status.generatedAt.
Do NOT run library:enrich / library:enrich-all / library:qa:openai / shelves:expand:aggressive until OpenAI quota restored AND milestones M0–M4 exit criteria met.

Do NOT start agent shelf-fill wave-4+ until: (a) frm/crma unique-concept bank review proves ≥80% distinct titles vs existing index, AND (b) workplaceTasks coverage on agent-authored cards ≥70%, AND (c) M0 ship-check freshness gate green. Stop volume waves when distinct concepts run thin (ops already warns this).

Do NOT run two index writers in parallel (enrich-library, agent-shelf-fill, expand-encyclopedia-shelves, codex-local-enrich, deepen-content, fill-spine-awareness). One holder lock; prefer scripts that use atomic-write + index-union.
Do NOT set enrichedAt on offline/agent/codex deepen — that stamp is OpenAI live enrich only. Use locallyDeepenedAt / agentAuthoredAt / codexDeepenedAt.
Do NOT republish orphan-family paths with enrichedOnly=true without also emitting a companion report of orphan steps that are deepened-but-not-live (visibility lie).
Do NOT invent offline filler / --allow-heuristic floods to chase shelf floors; quality-first banks only.
Do NOT expand Merixa sustainability zip/third-party academic sources (blocked / not Merixa-authored).
Do NOT commit secrets, .env, or OpenAI keys. Do NOT commit until user asks.
Push allowed after M1: origin configured and first push succeeded (627dd84).
Do NOT claim soft/public launch from hourly-progress or killer-app-plan nextExecutionOrder while enrich.status=paused.
Do NOT run library:seamless as a substitute for fixing the 3171 index↔runtime gap — seamless only publishes what the publisher selects; gap must be diagnosed first.
Do NOT reopen dual write paths that bypass atomicWriteFile / unionMergeWithDiskIndex (fill-spine-awareness raw writeFileSync is residual risk).

agents: Cursor agent for script/gate fixes (ship-check freshness, dual-writer audit, provenance stamps)
Cursor agent for Merixa-owned bank authorship (frm/crma residual ONLY after freeze conditions)
ownedDocs: Merixa×Codex practitioner glossaries (mostly consumed — residual 0 upgrades)

epics.successMetric: ops-status.json exposes truthBoard { liveSharePct, shipCheckFresh, competitivenessScoreInformational, banShipOnStructural:true }; AGENTS.md + ship-gates.json explicitly list banned metrics; any dashboard/script that printed 'passed' from ship-check-report older than index fails closed.

Patch AGENTS.md + ship-gates.json ban list: competitivenessScore, shelf pct, agent wave published counts are NOT release gates.
